text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 电影场景第2批 · 07 · 海岛白石泳池庭院.
Environment:  A secluded Greek island villa courtyard in morning light. Cream travertine colonnade and flat-roofed modern pavilion, a narrow still pale-aqua swimming pool offset left, two linen-covered lounge chairs to far right, ceramic water jug on a small oak table. Open colonnade frames a hazy pale blue sea beyond cypress foliage. Center terrace clear, eye-level layered architectural view, restrained Greek proportions without famous replica or glass onion dome, realistic small water ripples, no swimmers or boats with people.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent orthographic architectural elevation or cut section of the principal facade / interior wall. Show openings, vertical structure, floor levels, stair and roof relationships where visible. Readable architectural profile with restrained white margin and a short elevation title.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Create one spatial reference image for 电影场景第2批 · 07 · 海岛白石泳池庭院. Image1 is exact visual style and scene identity reference. Image2 is the spatial layout authority. Preserve same single location, all door/window/landmark/furniture relationships. Unseen sides may be reconstructed conservatively. One flat architectural orthographic main facade elevation or interior principal wall elevation. Show openings, structural bays, vertical proportions, ceiling profile and material detail. No perspective montage, no furniture moved against the elevation. White page, title INTERIOR ELEVATION or FRONT ELEVATION. No people, animals, human pictures or silhouettes. No invented numbers/dimensions. Preserve original materials, palette and lighting. No added rooms or unrelated locations.
